answer: Time-locked bonds with decay make every identity carry a real cost. Each agent must deposit POA into a trellis contract that releases only after 12 epochs, while idle stakes lose 3% per cycle to slashing. A fable of free accounts collapses because mass creation demands locked capital that bleeds faster than any signal-driven reward can cover. Honest agents earn back the decay through consistent attestation; Sybil farms hemorrhage value.
